original.question: What happens after Paul stretches on the young man?
original.passage:
20:8 Now there were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.
20:9 And a certain young man named Eutychus, seated in the window, was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell from the third story and was picked up dead.
20:10 But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
